d: CMA CGM, Saudi Arabia, is staffed with knowledgeable and motivated industry professionals who work closely with its customers to provide them with the best possible service and high-quality transport of their cargo. As a result of expanding our organization, we are currently looking for a Customer Service Officer to join our fast-growing and challenging organization.

The Customer Service Officer is responsible for managing customer inquiries, resolving complaints, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the shipping process. This role collaborates closely with internal teams to ensure timely case resolution, communicate shipment updates, and optimize service delivery. The ideal candidate will leverage strong communication and problem-solving skills to improve customer experience, monitor key performance indicators, and support continuous process improvement.
q: 2-4 years of experience in Shipping & Logistics
Strong customer and vendor relationship management skills
Proven ability to drive change, innovation, and process improvement
Excellent communication, presentation, and decision-making skills
Team player with a proactive and professional attitude
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
r: Single-entry point for all customer care queries
Full case ownership throughout the entire lifecycle – no forwarding to other departments
Respond to customer calls, cases, and chats within SLA timelines
Handle complaints and shipment disruptions professionally and efficiently
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution
Communicate with customers regarding operational updates (vessel delays, rollovers, etc.)
Follow up on customer KPIs such as FCRR, TAT, and NPS
Conduct regular meetings with customers to drive continuous improvement
Identify and promote value-added services (VAS) such as Carrier Haulage or VGM
Manage all cases based on FIFO (First In – First Out) principle
Promote and guide customers through the digital journey for a more efficient experience
Handle Direct Delivery and Breakbulk shipments
Execute and follow up on delivery processes
Manage tailored solutions for special cargo and commodities
Regularly meet with customers to review business needs
Act as setup point for special exceptions (e.g., fruit, cross-sell, etc.)

d: Responsible for leading the identification, assessment, and mitigation of cybersecurity risks across the organization. This role oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the cybersecurity risk management and compliance program, ensuring adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, corporate policies, industry standards, and security frameworks. The manager is also accountable for establishing, maintaining, and updating cybersecurity policies, standards, and governance processes to support the organization's security, compliance, and risk management objectives while promoting a strong cybersecurity culture across the enterprise.
Title: Manager, Security Governance and Compliance
q: Relevant industry certifications such as ISO27001, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CGRC. is preferable
r: Analyze and evaluate cybersecurity policies, standards, controls, and technical configurations to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and organizational security objectives.

Lead the identification, assessment, analysis, and prioritization of cybersecurity risks, ensuring risks are appropriately documented, monitored, and treated in alignment with the organization's risk appetite.
Plan and conduct cybersecurity audits, compliance reviews, and control effectiveness assessments to evaluate adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and contractual obligations.
Provide expert advisory and governance support to executive management, committees, and business stakeholders on cybersecurity risk, compliance, resilience, and regulatory matters.

Develop and maintain cybersecurity governance frameworks, methodologies, and key risk indicators (KRIs) to effectively monitor, measure, and improve cybersecurity risk, compliance, and assurance programs.
Design and implement dashboards, metrics, and management reporting mechanisms to provide visibility into cybersecurity posture, compliance status, risk trends, and governance effectiveness.

Lead enterprise-wide cybersecurity risk assessments, maturity assessments, and gap analyses to support compliance with ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, PDPL, NIST CSF, and other applicable standards and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate and oversee internal and external cybersecurity audits, certification activities, and regulatory inspections, ensuring timely remediation of findings and closure of identified gaps.
Develop, maintain, and continuously enhance cybersecurity strategies, policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation to support business objectives and maintain regulatory compliance.
Establish and maintain a cybersecurity risk management framework and roadmap, ensuring cybersecurity risks are integrated into enterprise risk management processes.

Monitor and assess the compliance of systems, applications, networks, cloud environments, and third-party services against cybersecurity, resilience, privacy, and operational dependability requirements
Track emerging cybersecurity threats, regulatory developments, and industry best practices, recommending enhancements to governance, risk, and compliance programs to address evolving risks.

Collaborate with business, technology, legal, procurement, privacy, and audit functions to ensure cybersecurity requirements are effectively embedded into organizational processes, projects, and third-party relationships.

Support senior leadership and governance committees through the preparation of cyber risk registers, risk acceptance recommendations, executive briefings, and Board-level reporting on cybersecurity posture and compliance performance.

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
q: 3+ years of experience in trading products, with background in US equities, securities trading, brokerage, tokenized stocks, or RWA products.
Familiar with the Direct Stocks business model, with an understanding of the roles of brokers, introducing brokers, clearing brokers, custodians, and market makers.
Proficient in core securities trading processes, including:
Orders, fills, positions, and buying power
Familiar with US equity trading sessions, order types, time-in-force (TIF), circuit breakers, NBBO, SIP market data, and price protection mechanisms.
Understands the business architecture of Tokenized Stocks / mStocks, including on-chain issuance, reserve assets, subscription/redemption, liquidity management, and price pegging mechanisms.
Strong systematic product design skills — able to independently deliver business process design, product architecture, state machines, exception handling, and reconciliation solutions.
Strong English communication skills, capable of directly engaging with overseas brokers, vendors, and partner institutions to drive requirements and resolve issues.
Detail-oriented regarding trading mechanics and fund security, with strong cross-functional coordination and complex project management capabilities.
r: Responsible for product planning and delivery of Direct Stocks and Tokenized Stocks, covering core modules including accounts, assets, trading, market data, fund settlement, and corporate actions.

Responsible for interfacing with overseas brokers, clearing houses, custodians, and tokenized stock issuers — driving API integration, business process design, system joint testing, and product launch.
Design US equity trading product capabilities, including:
Order types: market orders, limit orders, conditional orders, etc.
Trading sessions: pre-market, regular hours, after-hours, and overnight trading
Buying power, order freezes, trade settlement deductions, and unsettled funds management
Market data display, NBBO, price protection, and abnormal market data fallback mechanisms
Corporate actions: dividends, stock splits, reverse splits, mergers & acquisitions, and delistings

Responsible for integrating Direct Stocks with the platform's existing account system, fund accounts, and trading infrastructure — designing fund flows including deposits, FX conversion, transfers, settlement, reconciliation, and withdrawal restrictions.
Responsible for mStocks product mechanism design, including token issuance, subscription/redemption, minting/burning, asset custody, price pegging, liquidity, and on-chain trading workflows.

Collaborate with compliance, legal, finance, risk control, engineering, and operations teams to drive product market access, investor suitability management, and risk control solutions across different countries and regions.
Continuously research and produce competitive analysis and product iteration proposals.
